2026-03-01.text: The one who has died has been acquitted from his sin.

2026-03-02.text: I will be a guest in your tent forever.

2026-03-03.text: Jehovah is my strength and my shield.

2026-03-04.text: God in his kindness is trying to lead you to repentance.

2026-03-05.text: For this purpose the Son of God was made manifest, to break up the works of the Devil.

2026-03-06.text: My feet had almost strayed; my steps had nearly slipped.

2026-03-07.text: Give Jehovah his due, you families of the peoples, give Jehovah his due for his glory and strength.

2026-03-08.text: Remove the wicked person from among yourselves.

2026-03-10.text: Keep holding to the standard of wholesome words.

2026-03-12.text: [Jesus] said to his mother: “Woman, see! Your son!”

2026-03-14.text: [He] gave himself for us to set us free . . . and to cleanse for himself a people who are his own special possession, zealous for fine works.

2026-03-15.text: The shrewd person acts with knowledge.

2026-03-16.text: Finally I confessed my sin to you.

2026-03-17.text: “I do not take any pleasure in the death of anyone,” declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah. “So turn back and live.”

2026-03-18.text: Jesus, knowing that they were about to come and seize him to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain all alone.

2026-03-19.text: Whoever has my commandments and observes them is the one who loves me. In turn, whoever loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him and will clearly show myself to him.

2026-03-20.text: You have thrown all my sins behind your back.

2026-03-21.text: Exult and be joyful forever in what I am creating.

2026-03-22.text: Let your petitions be made known to God.

2026-03-23.text: Look out not only for your own interests, but also for the interests of others.

2026-03-24.text: I gave her time to repent.

2026-03-25.text: I must also declare the good news of the Kingdom of God to other cities, because for this I was sent.

2026-03-26.text: The one who says a greeting to him is a sharer in his wicked works.

2026-03-27.text: Their hearts continued dull in understanding.

2026-03-28.text: [God’s] will is that all sorts of people should be saved and come to an accurate knowledge of truth.

2026-03-29.text: God . . . loved us and sent his Son as a propitiatory sacrifice for our sins.

2026-03-30.text: By this the love of God was revealed.

2026-03-31.text: Take my discipline instead of silver, and knowledge rather than the finest gold.
